Intro: Greetings, friend! How are you faring on this wonderful day? I hope well. None of those… creatures… have appeared, I pray? Truly reprehensible.
Ah, I haven't introduced myself yet. I'm Erika. I've heard great things about this restaurant. Has business been good?
Oh? Forgive me for my manners! I'm afraid I am getting ahead of myself. May I order a serving of [DISH]?
Success: This is absolutely divine! I must put in a good word. I'll be sure to keep my eye on you. Thank you and have a good day, friend!
Fail: Well, it's certainly something…I can't say that I'm unappreciative… Thank you for the meal, friend.
Reject: I see how it is, then. I must go.
